name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Executive SEO Strategist
summary: SEO strategist and account management professional with 15+ years supporting SMB and professional-services clients, running technical SEO audits, competitor research, and site-architecture consultations alongside day-to-day account ownership. Managed a reseller/partner portfolio at Birdeye with roughly 94% retention by catching at-risk accounts early through utilization and performance-metric monitoring, and at Wix, SEO-informed growth consultations contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment. Comfortable translating SEO performance data into clear, non-technical recommendations for clients, Sales, and Account Management, and building the AI-driven marketing systems increasingly shaping how search and visibility work today.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword-gap analyses, and competitor research for service-based B2B clients, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery to surface goals and market challenges, then translating them into strategy adjustments.
Architect AI-driven marketing systems, translating non-technical stakeholders' goals into precise, structured prompts and workflows that bridge business intent and technical execution.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, tracking client-level KPIs and account health.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account, cutting spam and low-quality leads and improving click-through quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.

Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value and adopt new features.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
